corrections.claim: stage1_slab00.npz is UNCOMPRESSED (compress_type=0) 'so mmap_mode="r" works here'; the composite npz is DEFLATE-compressed so 'mmap_mode="r" is NOT usable' / 'silently fails/raises'.
corrections.correct_fact: mmap_mode is irrelevant for ANY .npz. Probed on numpy 2.1.3: np.load(stage1_slab00.npz, mmap_mode='r') returns an NpzFile and z['condition'] is a plain numpy.ndarray (isinstance(np.memmap) == False), fully read into RAM; the same call on the compressed composite npz neither raises nor warns — mmap_mode is silently ignored in both cases. Compression changes only the CPU cost, not the mmap-ability. (The practical advice — bind the key once per run — is still correct, for a different reason.)

corrections.claim: 'The left panel shrinks from 2.6 to 2.05 (~21% smaller)' and 'four columns x ~0.85 in width'.
corrections.correct_fact: width_ratios are normalized by their SUM, which changes from 5.75 to 7.0, so the shrink is far larger than the 2.05/2.6 ratio suggests. Measured with fig.canvas.draw() at figsize (7.2,4.4): axb 2.380 x 2.380 in -> 1.556 x 1.556 in = -34.6% linear / -57% area; axc (DMO condition) 1.053 -> 0.721 in (-31.5%); painted panels 0.916 -> 0.759 in (-17%). The painted panels are 0.759 in, not ~0.85 in.

corrections.claim: The proposed gridspec is 3x6 with width_ratios [2.05, 0.95, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0], wspace 0.06 ('this exact configuration was rendered and inspected').
corrections.correct_fact: This silently deviates from the change request. /mnt/home/mlee1/BIND/papers/01_pipeline/FIGURE_EDIT_PLAN.md:92-93 specifies 'Gridspec 3 x 6, width_ratios [2.6, 1.15, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0]'. Measured under the REQUESTED ratios (wspace 0.08): box 1.755 in, condition 0.776 in, painted 0.675 in — i.e. the request favours the left box, the spec favours the painted columns. The substitution may be the better design but must be declared, not slipped in.

corrections.claim: 'The DM column will therefore look like three near-identical images.'
corrections.correct_fact: Only the TOTAL is invariant (0.518% spread). Per pixel the rows differ by rms 0.133-0.137 dex, mean|ratio-1| = 0.229-0.236, log-space pairwise r = 0.952/0.955/0.955 — MORE decorrelated from each other than each is from the DMO condition (r = 0.966-0.972), and comparable to the gas column's own row-to-row scatter (0.155 dex). In the rendered mock the three DM panels are visibly different. The actual risk is the inverse of the one stated: a referee will see structure changing row to row and read pure sampling noise as feedback response.
r(log10 DM, log10 cond) = 0.9664 / 0.9699 / 0.9719 for rows 0/1/2 (the quoted 0.966 is only row 0).

corrections.claim: Risk: 'Deleting the fig.text ... the saved PDF's aspect ratio and physical width will shift slightly.'
corrections.correct_fact: Not slight: measured 7.113 x 3.409 in -> 5.988 x 3.409 in, a 15.8% width reduction. Under \includegraphics[width=\textwidth] the same content is then scaled up by 7.113/5.988 = 1.188, so every in-figure font/line renders 18.8% larger — a visible restyle, and generally the desired one.

corrections.claim: Risk: 'Any \includegraphics[width=...] in the LaTeX source that was tuned against the old crop should be re-checked.'
corrections.correct_fact: No such include exists. /mnt/home/mlee1/BIND/papers/01_pipeline/main.tex never references fig01_pipeline_diagram or figs_v2 at all — it still points at the previous figure set (figs/fig01_map_gallery.pdf, figs/fig02_validation_field.pdf, ...). All 13 includes use width=\textwidth except line 818 (figs/fig11_fgas_saturation.pdf at 3.5in). The figs_v2 suite is not yet wired into the draft.

The sentence begins with 'The' at the end of line 364 and runs to line 367; the parenthetical the spec wants to edit is on lines 365-366. Line numbers here happen to be unchanged by the concurrent edit, but the quoted anchor is one line short at the start.

additional_findings: CONCURRENCY HAZARD (most important): /mnt/home/mlee1/BIND/papers/01_pipeline/_build_figures_nb.py is being edited by another agent right now (item 3 of FIGURE_EDIT_PLAN.md landed between my first and last probe). Any change spec keyed to absolute line numbers will rot within minutes. The executing agent must anchor every edit on unique literal strings ('fig.text(1.015, 0.5,', 'gas3, y3 = [], []', 'gs  = fig.add_gridspec(3, 4', 'gnorm = LogNorm(') and re-grep immediately before editing.

STARS FLOOR IS DEFENSIBLE BUT UNDER-DOCUMENTED: at the proposed p70 pooled-nonzero floor only 13.9% / 5.7% / 3.2% of pixels per row are at or above vmin — but those pixels carry 99.5% / 99.1% / 95.4% of the stellar mass in that row. That is the number that justifies the choice and belongs in the provenance print, not just the decade count.

AMBIGUOUS BLACK IN THE STARS PANEL: because cmv.set_bad(cmv(0.0)) makes masked (exactly-zero) pixels identical to the vmin color, 'no stars' and 'stars below the floor' are indistinguishable in the rendered panel. Harmless but should be one clause in the caption.

ARROW GEOMETRY DEGRADES: the ConnectionPatch from axc to the leftmost painted column now spans a much larger gap relative to panel size (axc drops to 0.721 in). In my render of the spec's layout the three arrows become long diagonals sweeping across the 'paint with theta (30 astro params)' annotation. Consider drawing a single arrow to the middle row, or moving the annotation.

LEFT-PANEL TEXT OVERFLOW RISK: 'TNG300-Dark, 51 Mpc/$h$ slab' at fontsize 7 is ~1.26 in wide inside a 1.556 in panel (spec ratios) or 1.755 in (requested ratios) — 72-81% of the panel width. Drop it to fontsize 6 or shorten it.

THE FIGURE IS HEIGHT-STARVED, NOT WIDTH-STARVED: the saved crop is only 3.41 in tall out of a 4.4 in canvas because every imshow axes is aspect-locked and shrinks inside its cell. If the painted panels are judged too small, the cheap fix is to raise figsize height AND let the left box span fewer rows, or reduce the left box's width_ratio deliberately — not to widen past 7.2 in.

MEMORY IS A NON-ISSUE AT THE STATED SIZES: decompressing generated_patches costs 130.9 MB and thermo_patches 174.6 MB per run (transient), dmo is 70.5 MB, and large_scale (130.9 MB) is never touched. The spec's warning about '~400 MB per iteration' is correct in kind but comfortably inside the ~10 GB cgroup; the single-bind idiom is still the right call for speed (DEFLATE decompression of 131 MB dominates the cell runtime).
